name: My Valentine
source:
You're hired as a temporary worker at Clear Star Café. You'll be working alongside Finnley and Samson. In the process will you find your valentine? 

[From [url=https://love2drawmanga.itch.io/my-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你受雇成为晴星咖啡馆的一名临时店员，将与芬利和萨姆森并肩共事。在这段共事时光里，你能否寻得属于自己的情人节伴侣呢？

[摘自[url=https://love2drawmanga.itch.io/my-valentine]itch.io[/url]]
